title.narrative: BUILDING RESILIENCE, INCLUSIVENESS & CAPACITY OF H DCD 39114 SLE.HRDNSL.2024.01

description.narrative: The Building Resilience, Inclusiveness and Capacity of Human Rights Defenders (BRIC) in Sierra Leone seeks to strengthen the resilience of Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) through supporting their safety and protection mechanisms. It enhances the institutional and network capacity of district-based HRDs, increase human rights education, research and inclusion of youths in decentralized structures to promote human rights culture. The project has three specific outputs: (a) Enhanced capacities of human rights defenders at national and local levels, (b) Improved protection, safety and operating environment for human rights defenders at risk, and (c) Enhanced public outreach, advocacy and participation of youths in human rights.
